reason: ov032/daBakubaku_c: D1 (0x021111a0) sits BELOW D0 (0x021111f0) in the cartridge, but mwccarm emits the D2/D1/D0 group D0-first, so a real ~daBakubaku_c() member makes the whole-range link refuse with 'licensed .text functions are not emitted in ROM address order'. Both variants are therefore // @symbol mangled bodies inside extern "C" blocks, which costs those two functions the no-mangled-refs and no-raw-offset criteria. The other 21 functions in the TU are unaffected.
